text:
noah: noticed warmpool failing in us-west-2 after egress baseline landed. ~25 nodes sitting in joining.
ava: allocator: `kms dial tcp 10.210.5.11:443: connect: connection refused`
jordan: security recently denied 10.210.0.0/16 outbound as part of egress hardening. internal-kms is in that block.
kim: need fast mitigation. options: temp allow specific IPs, or flip routing through control-plane log-gw. temp allow is fastest.
security: we can approve a timeboxed allow (30m) for sg=compute-warmup -> 10.210.5.11:443. audit entry required.
noah: created PR infra/hotpatch-allow-kms-usw2. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "temp_allow_kms" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.210.5.11/32"]
  description       = "TEMP allow for node CMK unwrap during onboarding - 30m"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
}
```
deploy-bot: apply started infra/hotpatch-allow-kms-usw2 at 3290012360 by noah
infra-bot: canary check: 3/3 warmed at 3290012375
jordan: rolling to 20 nodes now. monitor billing for idle GPUs.
security: audit note logged: temporary egress exception approved by (noah/ava/jordan), TTL 30m. follow-ups: 1) implement egress-proxy for internal-kms, 2) document exception flow, 3) add decrypt e2e test.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/hotpatch-allow-kms-usw2 completed at 3290012388 by noah
noah: warm pool stabilized. opening infra#4809 for follow-up work and assigning to infra/security. closing alert. :thumbsup:
